input.content: You are a senior PLC control systems architect. Return ONLY valid JSON.

You are a PLC control software architect. Produce a concise architecture plan (at most 2000 words). Do not enumerate exhaustive traces. Return complete JSON with keys:
- state_machine: list of states and transitions
- timer_plan: timers required, PT durations, reset conditions
- priorities: safety and operational priorities
- initial_values: initial values for variables
- scan_execution_order: explicit 4-stage scan order (1. edge sampling, 2. safety/reset priority & state transitions, 3. unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF, 4. unified output assignments)
- formal_assertions: optional list of {"id": "A1", "formula": "G(...)"} temporal/invariant assertions over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names

SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "SELF010",
  "title": "Latched alarm with acknowledgment and reannunciation",
  "difficulty": "medium",
  "requirements": "# SELF010: Latching Alarm Annunciator with Acknowledge and Horn\n\n## Background\nISA-style latching alarm annunciator with acknowledgment and horn silence logic.\n\n## Functional Requirements\n1. Inputs: `Fault`, `Ack`, `Reset` (`BOOL`). Edge memory `previous_fault` initializes `FALSE` and updates on EVERY scan.\n2. If `Reset = TRUE AND Fault = FALSE`, clear `Alarm := FALSE` and `Acknowledged := FALSE`.\n3. Else if `Fault = TRUE`: set `Alarm := TRUE`; on a new `Fault` rising edge clear `Acknowledged := FALSE`, else if `Ack = TRUE` set `Acknowledged := TRUE`.\n4. Else (`Fault = FALSE` and no valid reset): retain `Alarm`, and if `Alarm = TRUE AND Ack = TRUE` set `Acknowledged := TRUE`.\n5. Set `Horn := Alarm AND NOT Acknowledged` on every scan.\n\n## Interface\n- **Inputs:** `Fault: BOOL`, `Ack: BOOL`, `Reset: BOOL`\n- **Outputs:** `Alarm: BOOL`, `Acknowledged: BOOL`, `Horn: BOOL`\n\n## Initial Values\n- `Alarm=false`, `Acknowledged=false`, `previous_fault=false`, `Horn=false`\n\n## Timing & Evaluation Conventions\nIf `Reset = TRUE` while `Fault = TRUE`, reset is ignored and the alarm remains active.",
  "scenario": "A panel alarm retains the event after a fault clears, silences the horn after acknowledgment, and sounds again for a new fault edge.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Fault",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Current fault condition"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Ack",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Acknowledge horn"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Reset",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Clear a removed fault"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Alarm",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Latched visible alarm"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Acknowledged",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Alarm acknowledged"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Horn",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Unacknowledged alarm horn"
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "Alarm": false,
    "Acknowledged": false,
    "previous_fault": false,
    "Horn": false
  },
  "scan_semantics": "At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "New fault edge reannunciates before Ack",
    "Reset only clears when Fault is absent",
    "Reset then precedes Ack"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "Fault": "I[k].Fault: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Ack": "I[k].Ack: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Reset": "I[k].Reset: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Alarm": "O[k].Alarm: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Acknowledged": "O[k].Acknowledged: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Horn": "O[k].Horn: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "first": "k=0; first invocation, not the pre-invocation observation",
    "rise": "Fault & !qFault.",
    "qFault": "{\"kind\": \"previous_sampled_input\", \"source\": \"I[k-1].Fault\", \"initial\": false, \"update\": \"After EVERY scan k, including invalid/reset/stop, store I[k].Fault\"}",
    "qAlarm": "{\"kind\": \"previous_observed_output\", \"source\": \"O[k-1].Alarm\", \"initial\": false, \"update\": \"After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].Alarm; never write into reference state.\"}",
    "qAck": "{\"kind\": \"previous_observed_output\", \"source\": \"O[k-1].Acknowledged\", \"initial\": false, \"update\": \"After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].Acknowledged; never write into reference state.\"}",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.Alarm=false, O_init.Acknowledged=false, O_init.Horn=false."
  },
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "SELF010.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF010.P1",
      "formula": "G(Horn <-> (Alarm & !Acknowledged))",
      "explanation": "Horn follows the latched acknowledgment state.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF010.P2",
      "formula": "G(Fault -> Alarm)",
      "explanation": "A present fault cannot be reset away.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF010.P3",
      "formula": "G(rise -> (Alarm & !Acknowledged & Horn))",
      "explanation": "Every new event annunciates despite simultaneous Ack.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF010.P4",
      "formula": "G((Reset & !Fault) -> (!Alarm & !Acknowledged & !Horn))",
      "explanation": "Reset clears a removed fault.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF010.P5",
      "formula": "G((!Fault & !Reset & qAlarm) -> Alarm)",
      "explanation": "Fault disappearance does not clear the visible alarm.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF010.P6",
      "formula": "G((!rise & !(Reset & !Fault) & Ack & qAlarm) -> Acknowledged)",
      "explanation": "Acknowledgment silences a retained event.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF010.P7",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "G(!Fault & !qAlarm -> (!Alarm & !Acknowledged & !Horn))",
      "description": "When no fault is active and no alarm was latched before the scan, Alarm, Acknowledged, and Horn stay FALSE even if Ack is pressed.",
      "explanation": "Forbids spontaneous alarm or pre-acknowledgment on idle scans.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF010.P8",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "G((qAlarm & !(Reset & !Fault) & !rise & !Ack) -> (Acknowledged <-> qAck))",
      "description": "When an existing alarm remains unreset without a new Fault rising edge or Ack, Acknowledged retains its prior value.",
      "explanation": "Preserves acknowledgment retention without requiring CompleteBehavior.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ]
}
